Product Tour
See how security teams use Axonius to build a comprehensive asset inventory to gain full enterprise stack assurance.
Asset discovery is the foundation every security decision is built on – and for most teams, that foundation is cracked.
Security teams aren’t struggling with a lack of data. They can’t trust the data they have. Axonius turns asset discovery from a periodic, error-prone exercise into a
continuously reconciled foundation
- so your inventory reflects reality, not a spreadsheet.
With Axonius, security teams
get a complete view into what exists
- the things you control, the things you don’t control (but should), and the things you can’t control. That confidence is what makes every downstream security decision faster and more defensible.
Get a Personalized Demo
Asset Discovery Without the Blind Spots
Comprehensive asset inventory
- Axonius connects to 1,400+ data sources - from endpoint agents and cloud providers to SaaS apps and identity and access management solutions - and correlates everything into a single, reconciled asset record. No more toggling between EDRs, cloud infrastructure, and IAMs to piece together a picture that’s already out of date
Surface the unknown
- known assets are only a part of the story. Axonius surface the unmanaged unknown, and ephemeral assets - cloud instances spun up daily, devices that fell out of agent coverage, inactive accounts - everything that traditional tools typically miss
A foundation built to last
- asset discovery isn’t point in time. Axonius continuously reconciles data cross sources so your inventory stays accurate as your environment changes, giving you the confidence to answer “what do we have and is it secure?” at any point in time
Get a Personalized Demo
The Asset Discovery Metrics That Tell You If Your Inventory Is Actually Working
Asset inventory completeness
Increase in total known assets discovered after connecting adapters to Axonius (for example, compare numbers in Axonius to your CMDB)
Inventory recency
Time elapsed between asset changes in your environment and changes in Axonius - a measure of how current your data is
Unknown Asset Reduction
Decrease in unmanaged or previously undiscovered assets identified using Axonius, reducing blind spots that create exploitable exposure
Axonius isn’t just security, it’s visibility for the whole enterprise.

See the Story
See How Asset Discovery Tools Work in Axonius: From Connection to Action
Step 1: See your full asset landscape
Instantly get a complete view of assets in your environment, with dashboards and charts that have detailed breakdowns of assets in Axonius from each adapter, historical asset discovery trends, and characteristics like OS distribution, network appliances and more. You can even see which assets are unmanaged or previously unknown.
Step 2: Connect data sources through API-based adapters
Asset data in Axonius is entirely configured through API-based adapters - no agents, no scanners required.  For example, the AWS adapter gives you the flexibility to pull in specific data like ECS and EKS clusters, VPNs, IAM groups, etc.
Step 3: Build correlated, high-fidelity asset profiles
As you configure adapters, Axonius builds an asset profile for every type of asset pulled into the platform. You’ll see details like MAC address, IP address, OS Type, Installed Software, OS Type and Version. These records are correlated across all adapters to give you a high-fidelity asset profile.
Step 4: Take action from a single platform
Visibility is great, but you need to take action on what you see. Using the Action Center, choose from over 600 actions across all adapters - send a notification, push files and commands, or open a ticket in your ITSM, isolate a device.
